items.title: Escrow forfeiture moves the balance in the correct direction
items.evidence: P0 MONEY DIRECTION, prod-verified verbatim. accounting.apply_escrow_posting_delta(): deposit -> +amount, release -> -amount, ELSE -> +amount. The forfeit posts posting_type='adjustment' with a POSITIVE amount, so a forfeiture INCREASES accounting.escrow_accounts.balance_cents while the JE DEBITS (reduces) the escrow liability - GL and subledger diverge by 2x the forfeit. LATENT: all escrow subledgers are 0 rows on prod and DRIVER_ESCROW_FORFEIT_GL_POSTING_ENABLED has NO row in lib.feature_flags at all (unknown key resolves false), so the route returns 409 forever and there is no enable path. FINANCIAL - build-and-HOLD, CPA VETO, owner Neon-applies; no agent flips that flag.

items.title: Escrow forfeiture writes the canonical driver subledger
items.evidence: SPLIT-BRAIN subledger. The forfeit writes accounting.escrow_postings only, while EVERY driver-facing balance reads driver_finance.escrow_balances / escrow_ledger (banking escrow visualizer + register, driver-detail Escrow History, the over-draw guard in escrow-forfeit.service.ts). So the balance the over-draw check reads NEVER decrements - the same escrow could be forfeited repeatedly - and no driver-facing surface shows a forfeit. driver_finance.escrow_ledger already carries an UNUSED 'forfeit' value in its transaction_type CHECK. LATENT: both subledgers are 0 rows on prod today. Fixing SAF-ORPH-01 alone leaves this open, so they are ONE CPA review.

items.title: Form 2290 deadline is per-unit and business-day correct
items.spec: Rule 15 research mandate — IRS Form 2290 instructions / FMCSA
items.evidence: The hardcoded 'Aug 31' STRING was removed, but the server computation it now trusts is still wrong twice. upcomingForm2290Deadline() always returns Aug 31 for the WHOLE company, ignoring per-unit first use - per IRS Form 2290 a vehicle first used after July is due the last day of the month following first use (a truck placed in service in October is due Nov 30) and this banner would never surface it; the per-unit proration that exists affects the TAX AMOUNT, not the DUE DATE. And there is NO weekend/holiday shift: Aug 31 2026 is a Monday so it is dormant, but 2024 (Saturday) and 2025 (Sunday) would have mis-rendered. The existing guard asserts only ISO shape and a 0-366 bound, so it would catch neither.
